data: SYNTHETIC. MuleCatch journey simulator (backend/intelligence/simulator.py). Not bank data.

protocol.note: metrics come from the test days only; the fitted model never saw the test days or the other seeds

systems.mule_only: Mule core alone (existing ring map and endpoint evidence)
systems.unified_no_fp_control: Unified score, false-positive controls switched off

fitted_spec.trained_on: synthetic journey simulator, seed 101, days 45-51 (4975 payments, 870 fraud)

model_gate.rule: fitted must not raise genuine interruptions by more than 0.05 pp, nor lower recall or REVIEW precision by more than 1 pp (means over the test windows of all seeds)
